name: 陳岡伯
objective:
This ESP (English for specific purposes) course is designed to cultivate students' ability to participate in critical discussion of topics or issues related to popular culture. In addition to enhancing students' vocabulary breadth, reading, and listening comprehension, this course puts emphasis on oral expression and writing. To achieve this, different multimedia materials including films, TV dramas, and animations are used to help students understand when and how to use language appropriately in various cultural contexts. 

In terms of principal contents, the course is divided thematically into 5 main teaching sessions that focus on important topics that are often explored in cultural products, including education, ethics, storytelling & characterization, and gender & sexuality. Ideally, the course aims to develop students' critical thinking and prepare them for advanced academic work in the fields of humanities.
schedule:
*The course with be conducted entirely in English (本課程以全英文授課為主，必要時以少許中文解釋專有名詞或較為複雜之概念)。

Week 1: Introduction

Unit 1 (Week 2-4): Humanities and life
Reading & Listening: creativity and education
Writing & Speaking: The Dead Poet Society

Unit 2 (Week 5-7): Moral dilemma
Reading & Listening: the trolley problem
Writing & Speaking: Scent of a Woman

Unit 3 (Week 8-10): Rethinking evil 
Reading & Listening: the banality of evil
Writing & Speaking: A Few Good Men

Unit 4 (Week 11-13): Storytelling & characterization
Reading & Listening: the tragic hero
Writing & Speaking: The Dark Knight

Week 14-15: Group presentation

Week 16: Final exam (written)

Week 17-18: Review, revision, & reflection
scorePolicy:
Attendance and participation: 30% (包含口說與寫作練習各 10%）
Joint exam: 20% 英文會考（閱讀與聽力)
Final exam: 25%
Final presentation: 25%
materials:
All materials (including weekly slides and handouts in English) will be provided by the instructor. 

本課程使用教師自編之主題式教材（短文閱讀、聽力演練與字彙擴充），並搭配與單元議題相關之電影場景，進一步學習特定情境之用語、培養分析問題與批判性思考之素養，並練習以清晰流暢的口語表達想法。

Students are encouraged to use AI tools such as Cool English (https://www.coolenglish.edu.tw/) for self-learning.
延伸教學與資源: ● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
